verdict.rationale: The platform itself is developed in the open at github.com/polarsource/polar under Apache-2.0, a permissive OSI license, with 10k+ stars. Polar positions itself as an "open source and transparent Merchant of Record", and the live llms.txt probe confirms the "Open Source" tagline. Missing for 10: an independent or hands-on check of the repository and its LICENSE file confirming the full production codebase is published.
